raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.19.1"
  build: 5
  # Quite often libml_dtypes-headers and ml_dtypes diverge.
  # https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/v2.18.0/third_party/py/ml_dtypes/workspace.bzl
  libml_dtypes_version: "0.5.1"
  ml_dtypes_version: "0.5.1"
  build_str_prefix: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | replace('.', '')) if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu_" }}

recipe:
  name: tensorflow-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version | replace(".rc", "-rc") }}.tar.gz
    sha256: fcfb3e88ab3eebdbab98a03c869a4d2616d52ea166c8d8021de1ef921b47be8d
    patches:
      - patches/0001-loosen-requirements.patch
      - patches/0002-Add-additional-absl_synchronization-linkage-to-gRPC.patch
      - patches/0003-Fix-missing-abseil-linkages.patch
      - patches/0004-Fix-protobuf_python-for-systemlibs.patch
      - patches/0005-Add-absl_log-systemlib.patch
      - patches/0006-Omit-linking-to-layout_proto_cc-if-protobuf-linkage-.patch
      - patches/0007-Fix-further-abseil-linkage.patch
      - patches/0008-Add-constraint-to-pybind11-systemlib.patch
      - patches/0009-Different-file-ending-for-flatbuffers-LICENSE.patch
      - patches/0010-Use-correct-hermetic-python.patch
      - patches/0011-Add-well_known_types_py_pb2-to-protobuf-systemlib.patch
      - patches/0012-Add-protobuf-toolchain.patch
      - patches/0013-fix-genproto.patch
      - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and cuda_compiler_version[:2] == "11"
        then:
          - patches/0014-Remove-some-usage-of-absl-str_format-in-CUDA.patch
          - patches/0015-Adjust-relative-path-for-libdevice.patch
      - patches/0016-Link-to-absl_log_flags-instead-of-absl_flags.patch
      - patches/0017-Update-ABSL-Log-Definition-for-libabsl_vlog_config_i.patch
      - patches/0018-add-absl_string_view-target.patch
      - patches/0019-add-absl_nullability-target.patch
      - patches/0020-add-absl_prefetch-target.patch
      - patches/0021-add-absl_die_if_null-target.patch
      - patches/0022-add-absl_crc32c-targets.patch
      - patches/0023-add-kernel_timeout_internal-target.patch
      - patches/0024-work-around-for-warning-that-clang-falsely-treats-as.patch
      - patches/0025-Hardcode-BUILD_PREFIX-in-build_pip_package.patch
      - patches/0026-Only-link-to-sparse_core_layout_proto_cc-headers.patch
      - patches/0027-Protobuf-5-compatability.patch
      # https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/86413
      - patches/0028-Avoid-linking-with-internal-nvrtc.patch
      - patches/0029-remove-dependencies-to-libcuda.patch
      # adjust patch 0004 for newer absl -- hmaarrfk - 2025/07/06
      - patches/0030-Fixup-pybind11_protobuf.patch
      - patches/0031-Update-linkages-for-new-absl-organization.patch
      # Already included in the release after 2.19.0
      - patches/0032-Remove-ambiguous-inherited-constructor-in-default_qu.patch
      # these came from https://git.yoctoproject.org/meta-tensorflow/tree/recipes-framework/tensorflow/files
      # check every release there for patches in the future
      # - patches/0033-third_party-ducc-fix-ambiguous-failure.patch
      # - patches/0034-third_party-tf_runtime-fix-compile-failure.patch
      # - patches/0035-support-to-build-with-gcc-15.patch
      - patches/0036-third_party-eigen_archive-workaround-ice-failure-whi.patch
      # for our system absl
      - patches/0037-add-absl_tracing_internal.patch
      # for the megabuild
      - patches/0038-Fix-building-different-python-wheels-from-one-python.patch
      - patches/0039-Fix-matmul-unused-result-error.patch
      - patches/0040-Support-cuda-12.8.patch
      - patches/0041-Disable-profiler.patch
      - if: aarch64 and target_platform != build_platform
        then: patches/0042-cross-arch-config.patch
      # backport https://github.com/openxla/xla/pull/22572 into vendored xla
      - patches/0044-PR-22572-Fix-build-break-in-convolution_thunk_intern.patch
      - if: aarch64 and target_platform != build_platform
        then: patches/0045-Force-python-wheel-architecture-to-aarch64.patch
      # missing <string> include with newer libabseil (20260107+)
      - patches/0046-Add-missing-string-include-in-custom_call_status_int.patch
      # missing <cstring> in vendored re2 with newer absl/GCC 14;
      # adds patch_cmds support to tf_http_archive
      - patches/0047-Add-patch_cmds-to-tf_http_archive-and-fix-re2-cstrin.patch
      # absl_low_level_hash merged into absl_hash in libabseil 20260107
      - patches/0048-Remove-absl_low_level_hash-merged-into-absl_hash-in-.patch
      # absl::Nonnull (nullability) missing from TSL system absl base BUILD
      - patches/0049-add-absl_nullability-to-tsl-system-absl-base-BUILD.patch
      - patches/0051-Add-nullability-dep-to-absl-base-system-BUILD.patch
      - patches/0053-Add-missing-string-include-in-nvtx_utils.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build + (200 if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else 0) + 25 * ((microarch_level | default("1") | int) - 1) }}
  skip:
    - win
    # TODO: debug issues with CUDA cross-compilation
    - aarch64 and cuda_compiler_version != "None"

outputs:
  # Staging output: runs the full Bazel build and installs all artifacts to
  # $PREFIX. No .conda package is produced; inheriting outputs select their
  # files via build.files (C libraries) or install via script (Python wheel).
  - staging:
      name: tensorflow-build
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: linux
          then: perl
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python 3.12.*
            - cython
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - nsync
            - snappy
            - giflib
            - libjpeg-turbo
            - icu
            - libpng
            - flatbuffers
            - onednn
            - if: linux
              then: onednn-cpu-threadpool
            - pybind11
            - numpy
            - zlib
            - libcurl
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        # Keep the cuda compiler here since it helps package solvers
        # decide on the cuda variant
        # https://github.com/conda-forge/tensorflow-feedstock/issues/162
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
        - if: linux and x86_64
          then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level | default("1") }}
        - bazel 6.*
        - bazel-toolchain
        - if: osx
          then: bazel-toolchain <0.3
        - libgrpc
        - libprotobuf
        - nasm
        - patchelf
        - sed
        - rsync
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: coreutils
      host:
        # GPU requirements for CUDA
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cudnn
            - nccl
            - cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and cuda_compiler_version[:2] == "12"
          then:
            - cuda-cupti-dev
            - cuda-cudart-dev
            - cuda-nvml-dev
            - cuda-nvtx-dev
            - libcublas-dev
            - libcusolver-dev
            - libcurand-dev
            - libcufft-dev
            - libcusparse-dev
            - libnvjitlink-dev
        # If 3.12 is changed, edit recipe/build_pkg.sh too
        - python 3.12.*
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - packaging
        - zlib
        - libpng
        - libcurl
        - if: not win
          then:
            - unzip
            - zip
        - openjdk >=8
        - nsync
        # TF_SYSTEM_LIBS
        - libabseil
        - astor
        - cython
        - dill
        - giflib
        - libgrpc
        - flatbuffers
        - icu
        - libjpeg-turbo
        - libprotobuf
        - libprotobuf-python-headers
        - openssl
        - pybind11
        - sqlite
        - snappy
        - ml_dtypes >=${{ ml_dtypes_version }},<1.0
    build:
      script: build.sh

  - package:
      name: libtensorflow_framework
    inherit: tensorflow-build
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libtensorflow_framework.so*
        - lib/libtensorflow_framework.*dylib
      skip:
        - win
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
    requirements:
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python
      run_exports:
        # tensorflow makes no ABI guarantees, need to pin to what we built with
        - libtensorflow_framework ==${{ version }}
      run:
        # avoid that people without GPUs needlessly download ~200-300MB
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: __cuda
    tests:
      - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
        then:
          script:
            - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libtensorflow_framework${SHLIB_EXT}
            - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/libtensorflow${SHLIB_EXT}

  - package:
      name: libtensorflow
    inherit: tensorflow-build
    build:
      files:
        - lib/libtensorflow.so*
        - lib/libtensorflow.*dylib
        - include/tensorflow/c/**
        - include/tsl/platform/ctstring.h
        - include/tsl/platform/ctstring_internal.h
        - include/xla/tsl/c/tsl_status.h
      skip:
        - win
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
    requirements:
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python
      run_exports:
        # tensorflow makes no ABI guarantees, need to pin to what we built with
        - libtensorflow ==${{ version }}
      run:
        # avoid that people without GPUs needlessly download ~200-300MB
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: __cuda
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libtensorflow_framework", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
        then:
          files:
            recipe:
              - test_libtensorflow.sh
              - test_c.c
          requirements:
            build:
              - ${{ compiler("c") }}
          script:
            - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libtensorflow${SHLIB_EXT}
            - if: build_platform != target_platform
              then: bash test_libtensorflow.sh

  - package:
      name: libtensorflow_cc
    inherit: tensorflow-build
    build:
      files:
        include:
          - lib/libtensorflow_cc.so*
          - lib/libtensorflow_cc.*dylib
          - include/**
        exclude:
          - include/tensorflow/c/**
          - include/tsl/platform/ctstring.h
          - include/tsl/platform/ctstring_internal.h
          - include/xla/tsl/c/tsl_status.h
      skip:
        - win
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
    requirements:
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python
      run_exports:
        # tensorflow makes no ABI guarantees, need to pin to what we built with
        - libtensorflow_cc ==${{ version }}
      run:
        - libml_dtypes-headers >=${{ libml_dtypes_version }},<0.6
        # avoid that people without GPUs needlessly download ~200-300MB
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: __cuda
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libtensorflow_framework", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
        then:
          files:
            recipe:
              - test_libtensorflow_cc.sh
              - test_cc.cc
          requirements:
            build:
              - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
          script:
            - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libtensorflow_cc${SHLIB_EXT}
            - if: build_platform != target_platform
              then: bash test_libtensorflow_cc.sh

  # 2021/12/29: hmaarrfk
  # as of tensorflow 2.7.0 we need the tensorflow-base package to break
  # circular dependency when building tensorflow extra packages. This annoying
  # circularity is broken upstream by the fact that they have to bootstrap
  # their builds.
  - package:
      name: tensorflow-base
    inherit:
      from: tensorflow-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      script: build_pkg.sh
      # tensorflow 2.18 doesn't support py313 until 2.20, see
      # https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/78774
      skip:
        - match(python, "3.13.*")
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
      python:
        entry_points:
          - tflite_convert = tensorflow.lite.python.tflite_convert:main
          - toco = tensorflow.lite.python.tflite_convert:main
          - saved_model_cli = tensorflow.python.tools.saved_model_cli:main
          - import_pb_to_tensorboard = tensorflow.python.tools.import_pb_to_tensorboard:main
          # The tensorboard package adds this entry point.
          # - tensorboard = tensorboard.main:run_main
          - tf_upgrade_v2 = tensorflow.tools.compatibility.tf_upgrade_v2_main:main
    requirements:
      # build requirements need to pick up the compiler run_exports (libgcc-ng etc.)
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
        - if: linux and x86_64
          then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level | default("1") }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
      host:
        # pip install of the pre-built wheel only needs Python tooling
        - python
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - packaging
        - wheel
      run:
        - python
        - packaging
        - absl-py >=1.0.0
        - astunparse >=1.6.0
        - gast >=0.2.1,!=0.5.0,!=0.5.1,!=0.5.2
        - google-pasta >=0.1.1
        - grpcio ${{ libgrpc }}.*
        - h5py >=3.11
        - ml_dtypes >=${{ ml_dtypes_version }},<1.0
        - opt_einsum >=2.3.2
        - protobuf >=5.26
        - python-flatbuffers >=24.3.25
        - requests >=2.21.0,<3
        - six >=1.12
        - termcolor >=1.1.0
        - typing_extensions >=3.6.6
        - wrapt >=1.11.0
        # TF-API needs to move in sync
        - tensorboard >=2.19,<2.20
        - keras >=3.5
        # avoid that people without GPUs needlessly download ~0.5-1GB
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: __cuda
        # https://github.com/conda-forge/tensorflow-feedstock/issues/296#issuecomment-1835781851
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None" and cuda_compiler_version[:2] == "12"
          then: cuda-nvcc-tools
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libtensorflow_framework", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libtensorflow_cc", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - exit 0

  - package:
      name: tensorflow
    build:
      # Meta-package: no-op script to avoid falling back to build.sh
      script: "true"
      # tensorflow 2.18 doesn't support py313 until 2.20, see
      # https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/78774
      skip:
        - match(python, "3.13.*")
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
    requirements:
      host:
        # Require python so that the python version gets populated
        - python
        # Keep the cuda version here since it helps package solvers
        # decide on the cuda variant
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: cuda-version ${{ cuda_compiler_version }}.*
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("tensorflow-base", exact=True) }}
        # avoid that people without GPUs needlessly download ~0.5-1GB
        # This also helps mamba give preference to the CPU build
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: __cuda
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - if: build_platform == target_platform
              then: tensorflow
          pip_check: true
      - files:
          recipe:
            - test_tensorflow.py
        requirements:
          run:
            - pip
        script:
          - cat test_tensorflow.py
          - test -x $PREFIX/bin/saved_model_cli
          - if: build_platform == target_platform
            then:
              - python test_tensorflow.py
              - tf_upgrade_v2 --help
              - tflite_convert --help
              - toco --help
              - test "${{ cuda_compiler_version }}" != "None" && python -c 'import tensorflow as tf; assert tf.test.is_built_with_cuda()'
              - test "${{ cuda_compiler_version }}" = "None" && python -c 'import tensorflow as tf; assert not tf.test.is_built_with_cuda()'
              # See https://github.com/conda-forge/tensorflow-feedstock/issues/364
              - python -c "import tensorflow as tf;graph = tf.function(lambda x:x).get_concrete_function(1.).graph;tf.compat.v1.train.export_meta_graph(graph=graph,graph_def=graph.as_graph_def())"

  - package:
      name: tensorflow-cpu
    build:
      script: "true"
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
      skip:
        - cuda_compiler_version != "None"
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("tensorflow", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - if: build_platform == target_platform
              then: tensorflow

  - package:
      name: tensorflow-gpu
    build:
      script: "true"
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
      skip:
        - cuda_compiler_version == "None"
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("tensorflow", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - if: build_platform == target_platform
              then: tensorflow

  - package:
      name: tensorflow-sse3
    build:
      script: "true"
      skip:
        - (not x86_64) or (microarch_level | default("1") | int) != 1
        # tensorflow 2.18 doesn't support py313 until 2.20, see
        # https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/78774
        - match(python, "3.13.*")
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
    requirements:
      host:
        # need to build per python version to pin to exact tensorflow package-hashes corresponding to sse3
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("tensorflow", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - tensorflow

  - package:
      name: tensorflow-avx2
    build:
      script: "true"
      skip:
        - (not x86_64) or (microarch_level | default("1") | int) != 3
        # tensorflow 2.18 doesn't support py313 until 2.20, see
        # https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/78774
        - match(python, "3.13.*")
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
    requirements:
      host:
        # need to build per python version to pin to exact tensorflow package-hashes corresponding to avx2
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("tensorflow", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - tensorflow

  - package:
      name: tensorflow-avx512
    build:
      script: "true"
      skip:
        - (not x86_64) or (microarch_level | default("1") | int) != 4
        # tensorflow 2.18 doesn't support py313 until 2.20, see
        # https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/78774
        - match(python, "3.13.*")
      string: ${{ build_str_prefix ~ "py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
    requirements:
      host:
        # need to build per python version to pin to exact tensorflow package-hashes corresponding to avx512
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("tensorflow", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - tensorflow
